body_markdown:
On Tuesday 15th Hafnia’s Operations team hosted its Technical and Operational Committee (TAOC) meeting of 2026.


The meeting took place at The Danish Shipowners Associations premises in Copenhagen, Denmark.


15 Pool Partners were represented during the day – with various discussions on matters relating to decarbonization, tradability factors and maritime security, – the latter of which has been a turbulent period over the last six months time.


Hans Tino Hansen (CEO, Risk Intelligence) made a special guest appearance talking about the global geopolitical situation with a particular focus on the maritime sector as well.


The TAOC meeting was followed by a team-building cooking experience.


We thank all participants for their interesting discussions and collaboration – and look forward to seeing our partners again in Spring 2027 during the next TAOC event.
